findings.title: Floors properly constructed, clean, drained
findings.comment:
Base cove is broken at the left of the walk in cooler and at the wall to the left of the grill prep cooler. 750-1200 The junctures between walls and floors shall be coved and sealed, or shall not present an opening of more that 1/32 of an inch. Replace tiles.
